notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) worked throughout - requests(curl) with a browser UA reached homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and every category listing page with HTTP 200. robots.txt: User-agent:* disallows only /my-account, /cart, /checkout, /search etc (not touched); ClaudeBot explicitly listed with 'Disallow:' (empty = allowed). No blanket disallow found. TREE METHOD: raw homepage HTML has an empty client-hydrated <nav> (categories not in SSR), so the live mega-menu JSON was located via one short Playwright network-capture pass (tier b, used only to discover the required 'x-tenant-id: luxury' request header) then fetched directly with curl (tier a) from apimw.tatacliq.com/content-aggregator-service/v1/luxury/layout-page/luxe-l1 - this returned the actual 'Home' tab mega-menu (Category Block 1/2/3: Kitchenware, Serveware, Decor, Home Furnishing, Storage, Health & Wellness). Cross-referenced against luxury.tatacliq.com/sitemap.xml -> Category-sitemap-1..7.xml.gz (downloaded+decompressed, ~6884 category URLs) to enumerate every leaf slug under each live mega-menu group (LSH14 code family: Bath=1416, Decor=1418, Home Furnishing=1420, Storage=1422, Kitchen=1414). Each candidate leaf page was fetched individually and validated via rel=canonical (matches requested URL) and the page's own contentful breadcrumb JSON (name chain e.g. Home>Bath>Bath linen>Bath Mats) since h1 is only SSR-rendered on zero-result pages. QTY METHOD: exact integer taken from the SSR-embedded pagination object 'pagination':{...,'totalResults':N} on each category listing page - this is the site's own paginated result count, not estimated/aggregated. Marketplace site (resells many brands) - counted only the site's own listed Home category nodes per the mega-menu+sitemap tree, not an inventory of which brands appear. EXCLUDED and why: (1) entire 'luxury-home-designer-*' URL family (LSH1410/1411/1412 codes, ~130 sitemap leaves) - not linked from the live 'Home' mega-menu, and 3 spot-checked pages all returned totalResults:0 with malformed single-word h1s (e.g. 'Covers','Cloth','Boxes') - treated as an orphaned/legacy taxonomy, not part of the current site's listed categories. (2) 'Indiluxe Home' vertical (ISH13xx codes, e.g. indiluxe-home-furnishings-bed-linen-*) - this belongs to a separate storefront reached via /explore/indiluxe (a different 'INDI' store tab in top nav), not the assigned luxury.tatacliq.com/home LUXE-store URL - out of scope for this SR. (3) Napkin Holders / Napkin Rings (table linen subgroup) - hardware/holder accessories, not fabric, excluded per textile.md curtain-hardware-style exclusion. (4) Cloth Drying Stand (Storage>Laundry & Storage) - a drying-utility item analogous to storage.md's explicit Ironing-Board exclusion, not a storage container - excluded. (5) Knobs (Storage>Organisers>Knobs) - cabinet/furniture hardware, not a storage product - excluded. (6) All Kitchenware/Serveware/Decor(furniture, home-accent, lamps&lights)/Health&Fitness leaves - Kitchen & Dining, Furniture, Lighting or Decorative-Accessories per boundary rules, out of scope for Textile/Storage. Low/medium-confidence rows (Dustbins, Garbage Bins, Rack, Racks and Holders, Hooks, Wall Shelves, Organisers>Accessories, Jars & Containers, Bolster Pillows, Dohars, Duvet Inserts, Table Mats, Cushions Covers) are ambiguous per the respective rulebook's own examples but were included because the website's own navigation explicitly places them under Storage/Home Furnishing (ambiguity-handling rule prioritizes the site's own classification) - flagged for review at LOW/MEDIUM confidence rather than dropped.
